exposure: Uterovaginal lesions were excluded as they were studied in a previous article
Patients were stratified by presence/absence of pelvic lesions
outcome: Diagnosis of pelvic lesions associated with female infertility
finding: MR imaging was 100% accurate in diagnosing  pyosalpinx, hydrosalpinx and hematosalpinx, ovarian and deep infiltrating endometriosis and benign and malignant ovarian tumors as benign cystic teratoma and serous cystadenocarcinoma.
